notes.subject: יאשמו
notes.rationale: 'karim rong / tok bilong rong' (KJV 'acknowledge offence') o 'lus olgeta / senis bel' (YLT 'desolate', wil masham — root mak 'ashamed' narapela lain).

notes.subject: kirap earli
notes.rationale: שחר i tok bilong klok moning i bruk — 'kirap earli long moning painim' — KJV 'seek me early'.

notes.subject: Efraim na Yuda
notes.rationale: Yahwe i tok long ol manmeri bilong en; ves 6:1 i gat ol i bekim tok.

translation: Bai mi go, bai mi go bek long ples bilong mi, skruim ol i tok bilong rong bilong ol, na ol i painim face bilong mi; long trabel taim bai ol kirap earli painim mi.

tokens.gloss: bai ol kirap earli painim mi
